@graph.name: AI Transcriber
@graph.description: Advanced AI-powered audio and video transcription service with high accuracy and multiple format support.

mainEntity.name: What file formats does AI Transcriber support?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI Transcriber supports MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, and M4A audio formats, plus MP4, AVI, and MOV video formats. Maximum file size is 200MB per upload.

mainEntity.name: How accurate is the AI transcription service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our AI transcription achieves 95%+ accuracy for clear audio recordings. Accuracy depends on audio quality, background noise, accent clarity, and speaking pace.

mainEntity.name: Is AI Transcriber completely free to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AI Transcriber is 100% free with no hidden costs, subscription fees, or usage limits. Simply sign in with Google and start transcribing immediately.

mainEntity.name: How long does audio transcription take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Processing time varies by file length. Typically: 5-minute audio = 1-2 minutes, 30-minute audio = 3-5 minutes, 60-minute audio = 5-10 minutes.

mainEntity.name: Is my audio data secure and private?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We use secure HTTPS encryption, don't store files on servers after processing, and require Google OAuth authentication for enhanced security.

mainEntity.name: Can I download or copy the transcribed text?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can copy transcripts to clipboard with one click or download as .txt files. Timestamps can be included or excluded based on your preference.
Yes, all transcriptions automatically include precise timestamps. You can choose to copy/download text with or without timestamps as needed.

mainEntity.name: What languages does AI Transcriber support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Currently optimized for English transcription with plans to expand to Spanish, French, German, and other major languages in future updates.

@graph.name: How to Transcribe Audio or Video Files
@graph.description: Step-by-step guide to transcribe audio and video files using AI transcription

step.name: Upload File
step.text: Click the upload button and select your audio or video file from your device.

step.name: Start Transcription
step.text: Click the 'Transcribe' button to begin the AI transcription process.

step.name: Review Results
step.text: Wait for the transcription to complete and review the generated text.

step.name: Copy or Download
step.text: Copy the transcribed text to clipboard or download it as a text file.
